The top of Most Popular is sticky: the top 12 rarely move more than a few places a day, and real competition happens below #20
new.rationale: Today the top 12 moved at most 4 places (Huss Valley +4) while every move of 10 or more places happened below #20. Needs weeks of daily moves to confirm.

new.statement: Games aged 4 to 12 months hit a mid-life trough: they rank below both 6-to-12-week hits and multi-year evergreens
new.rationale: Median pillar percentile by age today: 43-84 days 54, 123-365 days 40, over a year 55. Survivorship (only lasting games reach old age) may explain part of it.

new.rationale: Today's biggest climbers were all 26-83 days old (+201, +154, +148, +146, +135). If the lag is real, a game's efficiency should keep improving through its second month.

new.statement: A single 3 PM ET CCU snapshot flatters games whose players live in other time zones, so efficiency extremes below about 1,000 CCU are unreliable
new.rationale: The most efficient game by the metric is Korea Army (#487 with 115 CCU) at about 4 AM Seoul time. Confirming this would need CCU at another hour or a language flag.

new.rationale: Entries so far: Up-and-Coming to Top Earning 6, Up-and-Coming to Top Trending 5, Top Trending to Most Popular 5 (1-day lags). Only 2 days of entries; needs weeks.

new.statement: The steal/egg template is a popularity engine, not a monetization engine: strong on Up-and-Coming and among Most Popular risers, weak on Top Earning efficiency
new.rationale: Steal and egg games hold 5 of the Up-and-Coming top 10 and are 4 of 5 Most Popular risers, but 'Egg' titles (r=-0.50) and 'Steal' titles (r=-0.42) sit low on efficiency. Counterexample: Steal An Egg is #1 on Top Earning through sheer scale.

new.statement: Games pull players first and monetize later: breakout charts favor the newest games while monetization efficiency rises with age
new.rationale: Top Earning efficiency percentile: 22 at 42 days or younger, 46 at 43-84 days, 57 past a year. Up-and-Coming: 63 at 14 days or younger vs 45 at 15-42. Survivorship is a confounder.

new.statement: Breakouts touch all four charts during weeks 3 to 5 of their life
new.rationale: All 7 games on all four charts today are 21-37 days old (Huss Valley, Break and Steal an Egg, +1 Stone Skipping, Steal Animal Egg, Drill for Eggs, Steal ASMR!, Steal A Car).

new.statement: Meme-character waves (Verity, brainrot) spread across many small games at once and lift their Up-and-Coming and Top Trending entries for a few weeks
new.rationale: Verity appears in at least 6 tracked titles (Bunker vs Verity +35 on Up-and-Coming, Build and Kill Verity +22 on Top Trending). Watch whether these fade together.

new.statement: Cute job simulations with a hidden horror twist ('Anomaly' games) form a durable genre that reaches Most Popular
new.rationale: Animal Hospital (Anomaly) is #18 on Most Popular and #26 on Top Earning at 150 days; Animal Daycare (Anomaly) and Sell Fries! [Anomaly] followed. Needs more entries over time.
